newsitem.title: USA: Prominent lawyer killed twin sons, self -police.
newsitem.headline: Prominent lawyer killed twin sons, self -police.

text.p: A prominent entertainment lawyer shot and killed his 18-month-old twin sons and then shot himself dead, police said on Monday.

A Los Angeles police spokesman said William Billick, 53, general counsel of the Motion Picture Association of America, killed his two sons, Daniel and Alexander, on Sunday after arguing with his wife, Jacqueline, a violinist with the Los Angeles Chamber Orchestra. He then turned the gun on himself.
Police were treating the case as a double murder and suicide.
The spokesman said Jacqueline Billick, 35, telephoned police from a neighbour's house early on Sunday morning complaining that her husband had chased her from their home brandishing a pistol.

Shortly after officers arrived outside the Billicks' ranch-style house in the exclusive Los Angeles neighbourhood of Bel Air they heard a number of gunshots but did not immediately enter the home. Instead they tried to contact Billick by telephone, without success.
When officers eventually entered the house they found Billick and his twin sons dead in the master bedroom, the spokesman said.
